acceptedAnswer.text: “From Reporters to Robots: How AI is Reshaping Journalism” is a practical, plain-English guide to how AI is changing this field, what works in the real world, and what to watch out for.
It’s written for professionals, creators, founders, and curious readers who want useful insight without wading through academic theory.
No. It focuses on clear concepts, examples, and decision-making rather than heavy maths or code.

mainEntity.name: What will I get from it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll come away with a better grasp of the key AI use-cases, risks, and opportunities — plus how to think about adoption sensibly.
